---
applyTo: "README.md,docs/**/*.md"
description: How we write documentation in StudyBuddy
---
- Headings use sentence case: "How grades work", not "How Grades Work".
- Start every page with one sentence that says who it is for.
- Code examples use ES modules, like the code: `import { weightedAverage } from './grades.js';`
- Grades use the 1-10 scale, as in AGENTS.md: write 7.5, never 75%.
- Link to the code with relative links, like [grades.js](../grades.js).
